universe: 60 large US stocks (today's large caps, so survivorship flatters the results)
method: Each month-end the score is recomputed from data public on that date, then rank-correlated (IC) with the next 1 and 3 months of returns. t above about 2 is the usual bar for 'probably not luck'.

components.name: Smart money (13F)
components.reading: The only component that clears the bar, and positive in every era tested

components.name: Insiders (Form 4)
components.reading: No signal in mega caps; the cluster effect is found in smaller companies
